title: Definition of a Human Being and the Four Humors
english: A human being is a rational mortal animal, capable of intellect and knowledge. It is composed of four elements: namely, blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile.

Blood has its seat in the heart, and the breath is in the heart as well. Yellow bile is in the liver and in the stomach. Black bile is in the spleen and in the loins. Phlegm is in the brain and in the chest.
